note: Captured once from the published effect-dynamodb@1.40.0 and @effect-dynamodb/schema@1.40.0, installed outside the repo and run by a scratch script against DynamoDB Local. On DynamoSchema.make({ name: 'rp', version: 1, escapeKeys: true }), entities whose counts: Record<string, number> is configured { storedAs: SparseMap(), field: 'sr' }: Plain, Retained (versioned: { retain: true }), Series (timeSeries { orderBy: 'at', appendInput { id, at, counts } }), Deleted (softDelete: true), Keyed (sort key composite name), Lines (identifier lineId, the target of aggregate Sheets' ref edge line) and Tallies (the read model of a projection of stream Count, folding Counted { key, by } into counts, checkpoint version). Each case puts its row with counts { a: 1 } and leaves the map whole (sr), as entries (a raw SET counts#a = 1 REMOVE sr) or both (a raw SET counts#a = 7 beside sr); rekey's row (name 'x y') is moved by raw writes to the sort key 1.36 composed, unescaped (x y where the head composes x%20y), with its map left in the same three forms. Recorded: the outcome, every request the case sent, whole and in order, every row of the table after it, and what the read back returned; the table's name is <table>, UUIDs and the projection's write token (__edd_wt__) <token>, and timestamps, a tombstone's sort key's included, <time>. Never regenerate it: it is the record of what 1.40.0 did.
